title: Amazon API Gateway Websocket API with VPC Link integration
description: The AWS SAM template deploys an Amazon API Gateway Websocket API endpoint with a VPC Link integration.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern deploys an Amazon API Gateway WebSocket API endpoint with a VPC Link integration to an internal Network Load Balancer (NLB).
WebSocket APIs with VPC Links allow bidirectional communication between clients and backend services hosted in private VPCs.
See the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.

authors.name: Manasvi Jain
